task.title: Post Installation
task.shortdesc: This section describes how to verify if the is connected and transmitting data.

context.p: This section describes how to verify if the is connected and transmitting data.
After the is installed and configured, the device starts sending data to the . It is important to check and verify if the device is connected fully and transmitting the data.

step.cmd: Log in to the using your login credentials.
Check that the device is visible in learning mode. The learning mode is displayed in blue on the dashboard.
Tap List and search for the corresponding motor name. It should be displayed with the status Learning.

info.p: To check that the device is correctly sending data to the :

step.cmd: Select the corresponding location associated with the motor.
From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding process, plant, and motor name.

fig.title: History Plot tab and Parameters sub-tab

step.cmd: Tap Select Vibration to select any parameter.
Tap Select Date and Select Time to select the date and time corresponding to the moment of the installation.

result.p: You should see the corresponding waveform.
